text: Assumption: The calling context of the application function is the cyclic DCM task — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: The calling context of the application function is the cyclic DCM task — is this correct?
norm: the calling context of the application function is the cyclic dcm task
assumption: The calling context of the application function is the cyclic DCM task.
rationale: The exact task context for calling the application function is not explicitly stated in SWS_Dcm_00804. The asynchronous semantics with DCM_E_PENDING and the non-reentrant property point to the cyclic DCM task.

original.rationale: Der genaue Task-Kontext für den Aufruf der Applikationsfunktion ist in SWS_Dcm_00804 nicht explizit genannt; die asynchrone Semantik mit DCM_E_PENDING sowie die Nicht-Reentranz deuten auf den zyklischen DCM-Task hin.
